title: Andre & Maksim, first time out
body: In August the two played on separate teams — Andre finished 8th with Veronika, Maksim took 3rd alongside Fyodor. Paired together for the first time on September 5, they went 10–1 and won the whole tournament.

title: The champions' hard landing
body: Alexander P. & Anastasia A. won every single game in August, 11–0. Five weeks later, same partnership, they won just 3 of 11 and slid to 10th — the steepest fall of anyone who played both days.

title: Aulis & Anna hold the spoon
body: The only pair to finish dead last on both tournament days — 1 win out of 11 in August, and 1 win out of 11 again in September. Full marks for showing up.

title: A new partner did wonders for Alexey A.
body: Partnered with Maria in August, Alexey A. won 7 of 11 games for 5th place. With Vitaliy as his September partner instead, he jumped to 9 wins and runner-up — one game off the title.

title: Alla & Zhenya, nine wins, every time
body: Across three tournament days with three different field sizes — 10, 12, then 14 pairs — Alla & Zhenya won exactly 9 of 11 games each time. A podium finish on all three days, and the steadiest record anyone's put up so far.

title: Taivi & Alain's three-tournament slide
body: 3rd place with 8 wins on August 22, 6th with 6 wins a week later, then 11th with just 3 wins on September 5 — a clean, steady decline across every tournament day they've played.
